subject.title: fix(agent): exit nonzero when gateway runs do not complete

question: Should `openclaw agent` formally treat gateway `timeout`, `error`, and `cancelled` responses as nonzero process outcomes for existing automation consumers?
rationale: The patch fixes a documented false-success defect, but nonzero exit codes change the observable shell contract for callers that may currently consume a returned failure payload while accepting process success.

options.title: Adopt corrected failure semantics
options.body: Merge the patch so terminal non-success gateway responses consistently produce non-success status and exit code while retaining the emitted payload.

options.title: Preserve exit-zero compatibility
options.body: Keep the corrected response classification but require an explicit compatibility mode or a separately approved migration path before changing the CLI process outcome.

recommendation.title: Adopt corrected failure semantics
recommendation.body: Merge the patch so terminal non-success gateway responses consistently produce non-success status and exit code while retaining the emitted payload.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available owner for accepting a core gateway-to-CLI compatibility contract, with low confidence because direct file-history inspection was unavailable.
